title: Mapping the Emerging Social Science of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.07598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape communication, learning, work, creativity, and decision-making, yet social-science research on these developments remains fragmented. We map this emerging field using a curated corpus of 198 papers reviewed in full and a field-scale corpus of 47,719 published papers from five bibliographic databases. Combining sentence embeddings, K-means clustering, within-cluster Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), author and LLM classifications, and structural topic modeling, we identify three domains: LLM as Social Minds, examining socially interpretable model behavior; LLM Societies, examining collective dynamics among interacting model-based agents; and LLM-Human Interactions, examining how people perceive, use, and are affected by LLMs. These domains contain 13 subcategories spanning reasoning, personality and bias, behavioral games, collective intelligence, simulation, trust, work, creativity, and

translated_title: 大语言模型新兴社会科学的图谱绘制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益影响着人类的沟通、学习、工作、创造力和决策，然而针对这些发展的社会科学研究仍然较为零散。我们利用一个经精心筛选、全文审阅的198篇论文语料库，以及来自五个文献数据库的47,719篇已发表论文构成的领域规模语料库，对这一新兴领域进行了系统图谱绘制。通过结合句子嵌入、K-means聚类、簇内潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）、作者与LLM分类以及结构主题建模等方法，我们识别出三个研究领域：LLM作为社会心智——研究具有社会可解释性的模型行为；LLM社会——研究基于模型的交互智能体之间的集体动态；LLM-人类交互——研究人们如何感知、使用大语言模型以及受到其影响。这些领域包含13个子类别，涵盖推理、人格与偏见、行为博弈、集体智能、仿真模拟、信任、工作、创造力等方面……
tldr: 本文通过对近5万篇论文进行多方法计算文本分析，首次系统绘制了大语言模型社会科学这一新兴领域的研究图谱，将其划分为“LLM作为社会心智”、“LLM社会”和“LLM-人类交互”三大领域及13个子类别。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic map of the emerging social science of LLMs, using computational text analysis of nearly 48,000 papers to identify three domains—LLMs as Social Minds, LLM Societies, and LLM-Human Interactions—comprising 13 subcategories.
